paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: The PaLM 540B model achieves over 90% accuracy on the two-sentence version of the cause and effect task, whereas the 8B model performs close to random chance on the same task.

evidence.quote: In contrast, the 540B model is able to solve the two sentence version and achieves over 90% accuracy, demonstrating the general language modeling capabilities that scale can unlock.
the smaller PaLM models perform poorly on the two sentence version of this task, with the 8B model scoring close to random chance
